verdict.rationale: Railway cloud agents keep running on a persistent remote machine after you disconnect, so coding agents like Claude Code or Codex can keep working in the background (railway-docs-22, -23, -24). The built-in Railway Agent can operate the platform on your behalf, diagnosing failures and opening fix PRs, though it is chat-driven and invoked on demand rather than set up as a standing automation (railway-docs-25, -26, -28). Condition-based alerts add a limited trigger mechanism but notify rather than act (railway-docs-9). Missing for 10: a documented way to define scheduled or event-triggered agent automations that run without a prompt, any evidence the Railway Agent acts unprompted, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
